title: Screen mode and box schemes
what: The light, dark and system screen mode kept in a cookie and read by the page, and the scheme a box or a theme picture stands in apart from the page (app/domain/scheme.ts, shared/screen-mode.ts).

title: Palettes
what: The six palettes, each the reader's own ground and everyone else's in both modes, the default teal, and the token declarations that state them (shared/palettes.ts).

title: Theme and palette pictures
what: The small pieces that draw a theme or a palette in one mode on their own box: a screen fragment, a theme's accent and grey dots, and a palette's two grounds.

title: Themes
what: The five themes, each an accent and a neutral grey with the key of its name, the default teal, and the token and head declarations a chosen theme is stated by (shared/themes.ts).
